concept: IAM: aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent condition for sensitive actions
tests: How to enforce MFA for all IAM principals before sensitive API actions.
expected: IAM policy with the condition aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent = true for sensitive actions (e.g. ec2:TerminateInstances). Triggers: "enforce MFA", "before sensitive actions", "all IAM principals".
why_not: MFA only on root doesn't cover other principals; a password policy doesn't require MFA; a security group controls network traffic, not API permissions.
